title: Adguard Family Plan Lifetime Subscription - 9 Devices US$8.80 (~A$12.60) + 10% GST @ StackSocial
body:

Although do have to keep making sure to remember to turn it off for cashback

Thanks for the tips.

Android TV: Smart tube/Tizen Tube Cobalt

[cobberboy] It's confusing. They have 3 separate products:
Adguard ad blocker (per this deal)
Adguard DNS
Adguard VPN
[3dprintdeals] alternatively you can self host Adguard Home
[hornbill] Was keen for this until a quick read up saw Russian connection so I’m out. Company not based there anymore though and good deal if you’re willing to risk it.

BEANS20 seems to work too as an alternative.
